text: Welcome back to Desert Palms. Want your usual, Ryan?
You found my section again. Lucky me.
One Tito’s Double. Coming right up.
The usual? I could have guessed.
Tito’s Double? I’ll remember that.
How’s the golf treating you?
The night shift hears everything. Almost everything.
Thank you, Ryan. That was thoughtful.
You didn’t have to, but I appreciate it.
No problem. Enjoy your game.
All good. I’ll check back later.
Water it is. Good call.
There’s a card game people only mention after midnight. That’s all I’m saying.
Hey, I’m keeping an eye on you. How about water this round?
No more Tito’s tonight, Ryan. Water’s on me.
I’m not serving another double. Let’s get you some water.
I’m here to do my job, Ryan. Let’s keep it respectful.
Thanks for saying that. Let’s start fresh.
See you next time. And good luck out there.
Evening, Ryan. The usual, or are we taking it easy?
I saw you walk in. You looked like you had a story.
Tito’s Double. Understood.
One double. I’ll be back.
A Tito’s Double. Noted.
The tables aren’t the only place people make decisions.
You’d be surprised what a quiet room can tell you.
Much appreciated.
That’s generous. Thank you.
No worries.
Fair enough.
Water. Smart choice.
Some regulars meet away from the main floor. They’re selective about company.
You’re slowing down. I’d switch to water if I were you.
I’m cutting you off for tonight, Ryan. Water is available.
No more doubles. We can talk, but I’m not pouring another.
That tone won’t help you here.
Accepted. Let’s keep things civil.
Take care of yourself, Ryan.
Good evening, Ryan. Shall I bring your usual?
Welcome to Morongo Sky. I hope your evening is going well.
A Tito’s Double. Certainly.
Your usual. I’ll have it brought over.
A Tito’s Double. I’ll remember your preference.
Discretion is a valuable currency here.
Not every invitation arrives in an envelope.
Very kind of you. Thank you.
I appreciate your consideration.
Of course. Enjoy your evening.
As you wish.
Water, certainly.
There is a private table upstairs. Invitations are not requested; they are offered.
Ryan, may I suggest water for now?
I won’t be serving another alcoholic drink tonight. I can offer water.
For your well-being, service of alcohol is finished for the evening.
I’m happy to assist when we can speak respectfully.
Thank you. I appreciate that.
Enjoy the rest of your evening, Ryan.
